# netcup_dns_records (Data Source)

All DNS records of a netcup-hosted zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_dns_records" "all" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "records" {
  value = data.netcup_dns_records.all.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Zone (domain) to read, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Records found in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) Record value.
- `hostname` (String) Record host.
- `id` (String) netcup record id.
- `priority` (String) Record priority.
- `type` (String) Record type.
